extracted.name: Peanut Butter Banana Quesadilla
extracted.description: These sweet and simple quesadillas with peanut butter and banana are a light yet satisfying treat — perfect for breakfast, a midday snack, or dessert!
instruction_lines: Spread 2 tablespoons peanut butter onto each tortilla. Top one tortilla with banana slices, then cover with remaining tortilla, peanut butter-side down.
Spray cooking spray into a skillet and heat over medium heat. Place quesadilla into the hot skillet and cook until lightly browned, about 3 minutes per side. Cut in half to serve.
